qa_pairs.question: What component is being referenced under section 12 61?
qa_pairs.answer: Oil pressure, oil temperature, oil level display

qa_pairs.question: What special instruction is given for the oil pressure switch installation?
How many different torque specifications are listed for the oil pressure switch?
qa_pairs.answer: Three different specifications: 20 Nm, 27 Nm, and 35 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque difference between M60/M62/M73 engines and all other engines for the oil pressure switch?
qa_pairs.answer: 8 Nm difference (27 Nm for M60/M62/M73 versus 35 Nm for all others)

qa_pairs.question: Which section of the Engine Electrical System covers oil pressure and temperature components?
